find: return KICK * (1 - k) * Math.abs(Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 2 * CYCLES));
replace: return KICK * (1 - k) * Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 2 * CYCLES);
why: Drops the `abs`, so the second half of every cycle drives the barrel FORWARD along the bore -- the gun lunging at its target. Recoil is a backward motion by definition; a gun that thrusts out reads as something else entirely, and since #526 this plays on every shot, so the wrong sign would be on screen constantly rather than only on a refusal.
